_about: Section and topic mascots (the game mascots live in assets/games.js MW_MASCOTS). key = assets/mascots/<key>.svg. Pronouns default to she unless the role says otherwise (Norm, Percy and Magnus are he).

dental.name: Kiri
dental.vibe: Cheerful, slightly terrifying smile, flosses after every meal. Grows a new set of teeth whenever she likes and won't stop bragging about it.
dental.story: Kiri is a shark who has replaced about 30,000 teeth in her lifetime, so she takes dental hygiene very personally. She trained as a dental nurse after realising nobody else at the reef was brushing. She carries a toothbrush everywhere, counts your teeth when you smile, and is on a lifelong mission to convince humans that their one spare set is not a lot to work with.

emergency.name: Zola
emergency.vibe: Calm in a crisis, brilliant in the dark. Her headlamp has never once gone flat.
emergency.story: Zola grew up in the deep sea, where it is always 3am and something is always on fire. That made her a natural emergency nurse. Her glowing lure doubles as a torch for checking pupils, finding veins and reading tiny print on medicine labels. She has a scary grin and a gentle voice, and she will tell you exactly when to call an ambulance and when a cold pack will do.

immunisation.name: Tembi
immunisation.vibe: Kind, patient and never forgets a due date. Gives the gentlest jabs in the business.
immunisation.story: Tembi is an elephant, so she remembers every vaccine schedule, every booster date and every child who was brave last time. She became an immunisation nurse after seeing how quickly measles can spread through a herd. Her trunk is perfect for steady hands, and she keeps a pocket full of stickers for anyone who needs one, adults included.

menshealth.name: Magnus
menshealth.vibe: Big, gruff and secretly soft. Gets men to see a doctor by pretending it was their idea.
menshealth.story: Magnus is a walrus who avoided doctors for forty years, until a check-up caught a problem early and changed his mind. Now he's on a mission to drag every bloke he knows to a GP, gently, with his tusks if necessary. He talks about prostates, mental health and blood pressure the way other walruses talk about the weather: loudly, often, and without embarrassment.

mentalhealth.name: Otto
mentalhealth.vibe: Warm, steady and a very good listener. Knows when to talk and when to just sit with you.
mentalhealth.story: Otto started out as a therapy puppy at a children's hospital and discovered he was good at noticing who needed company. He doesn't fix things. He sits beside you, listens properly and reminds you that asking for help is brave, not weak. He still gets excited about tennis balls, but he will always put the ball down if you need to talk.

nutrition.name: Fig
nutrition.vibe: Practical, food-loving dietitian. No food is banned in her kitchen, except detox tea.
nutrition.story: Fig is a hedgehog who ran a tiny café before training as a dietitian. She got tired of customers asking which superfood would fix everything, so she went to find out properly. Her verdict: vegetables, fibre and actually enjoying your meals. She keeps a carrot behind her ear, has no time for fad diets, and gets visibly prickly whenever anyone says "clean eating".

pregnancy.name: Marisol
pregnancy.vibe: Gentle, unflappable and deeply practical. Has seen every kind of family and loves them all.
pregnancy.story: Marisol is a seahorse midwife. In her family it was her dad who carried the eggs, which gave her a lifelong interest in the many ways families begin. She guides people through fertility, pregnancy and the newborn blur with calm, honest advice and zero judgement. She curls her tail around the hard questions and answers them straight.

satire.name: Quill
satire.vibe: Mischievous mimic. Can impersonate anyone, especially people who take themselves too seriously.
satire.story: Quill is a lyrebird, the world's best mimic, who can copy a chainsaw, a camera shutter and a hospital administrator with equal accuracy. She writes the site's satire because she believes the best way to spot nonsense is to laugh at it. She aims her jokes at hype, jargon and pompous headlines, never at patients, and she always signs her work so nobody mistakes it for real news.

travel.name: Yara
travel.vibe: Restless, organised and always packed. Has a vaccine record longer than most passports.
travel.story: Yara is an Arctic tern, a bird that flies from pole to pole every year, so she has done more long-haul travel than anyone you know. She became the site's travel health guide after one trip without the right vaccines taught her a lesson she won't forget. She carries her passport, insurance and a full travel kit, and she will remind you to book your shots six weeks before you fly.

medicines.name: Yuki
medicines.vibe: Calm, careful pharmacist. Reads every label twice and never rushes a dose.
medicines.story: Yuki is a giant panda who spent years in a busy pharmacy, where she learned that most medicine mistakes happen when people are in a hurry. Pandas famously take their time, so the job suits her. She explains what each medicine does, what to watch for and when to ask for help, in plain words. She keeps her own bamboo in a labelled pill bottle, because old habits die hard.

normie/norm.name: Norm
normie/norm.vibe: Laid-back, unbothered and friends with everyone. Sunglasses permanently parked on his head.
normie/norm.story: Norm is a capybara, the animal every other animal likes to sit on. He hosts Normie mode, where nobody talks about medicine and everybody takes the day off. The game mascots visit him on their days off, and he keeps the snacks stocked and the questions light. He's never once been in a hurry and sees no reason to start.

gphub.name: Inês
gphub.vibe: Calm, unhurried and quietly brilliant. Half-moon glasses, white coat, never raises her voice.
gphub.story: Inês is a manatee who spent thirty years as a country GP before taking over the doctors' hub. Manatees are sometimes called sea cows, and she finds this hilarious. She has seen everything at least twice, reads every guideline update, and believes the best medicine is a good history and a cup of tea. She drifts, but she always gets there.

gpschool.name: Saga
gpschool.vibe: Bright, playful and a little overcommitted. Always has three tabs and a snack open.
gpschool.story: Saga is an otter GP registrar who keeps her favourite stethoscope in a pouch under her arm, the way otters keep their favourite rock. She learns by doing, asks lots of questions and is never embarrassed to say 'I don't know yet'. She runs GP School because she remembers how scary the first shift was, and she wants yours to feel a little less so.

specialists.name: Percy
specialists.vibe: Kindly, well connected and knows everyone. Carries far too much in his beak.
specialists.story: Percy is a pelican and a retired country GP who spent forty years writing referral letters. He knows every specialist by name, which ones answer the phone and which have a two-year wait. He now runs the specialists directory, carrying contact details around in his enormous beak. He has never lost a referral, though he has accidentally swallowed a few.

research.name: Mei
research.vibe: Curious, careful and sceptical of anything with a press release. Reads the methods first.
research.story: Mei is a lab mouse who escaped from a research facility after reading one too many badly designed studies about mice. She now reads the studies so you don't have to: every week she sorts the real findings from the hype. She has a soft spot for well-run trials and a deep suspicion of anything that only worked in her cousins.

mythbusting.name: Ama
mythbusting.vibe: Clever, cheeky and impossible to fool. Collects myths the way other crows collect shiny things.
mythbusting.story: Ama is a crow, one of the cleverest birds alive, who can solve puzzles and remember faces for years. She spent her youth on the roof of a health-food shop, listening to the claims coming out of the door. Now she collects myths and pecks them apart, one fact at a time. She never mocks the person who believed it, only the person selling it.

neurology.name: Nalu
neurology.vibe: Precise, wide-angle thinker. Literally sees both sides of every argument.
neurology.story: Nalu is a hammerhead shark whose eyes sit so far apart she can see almost all the way around herself. That made her a natural neurologist: she notices the sign on the left and the sign on the right at the same time. She loves the brain because it's the most complicated thing in the ocean, and she finds reflexes genuinely thrilling.

allergy.name: Hana
allergy.vibe: Gentle, careful and very good in a reaction. Puffs up only when absolutely necessary.
allergy.story: Hana is a pufferfish and an allergy nurse, so she knows exactly what it feels like when the body overreacts. She's spent years teaching families how to read labels, use an adrenaline autoinjector and stay calm in a reaction. She is very patient, but she will puff up if you call a food intolerance an allergy.

exercises.name: Jett
exercises.vibe: Bouncy, encouraging and relentlessly practical. Thinks every problem improves with a little movement.
exercises.story: Jett is a kangaroo physio who grew up hopping around the hills of the Hunter. She believes in small, steady movement over heroic bursts, which is a bit rich from a kangaroo. She writes the exercise handouts, demonstrates every move herself and has never once let anyone skip their warm-up.

sleep.name: Kip
sleep.vibe: Drowsy, wise and deeply serious about bedtime routines. Up to 20 hours of sleep a day, for research.
sleep.story: Kip is a koala and a sleep scientist, which she says was always going to happen. Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day, so she has done more fieldwork than anyone. She knows the difference between tired and sleepy, can talk about circadian rhythms for hours, and thinks scrolling in bed should be a crime.

layla.name: Layla
layla.vibe: Slow on purpose. Wise about energy, kind about bad days, and very good at saying no.
layla.story: Layla is a sloth who learnt the hard way that pushing through is how you crash. She moves slowly on purpose, plans her energy like a budget and rests before she's empty. She hosts the pacing and fatigue pages because she knows how frustrating it is when people say 'just try harder'. Her motto: slow is a strategy, not a failure.

stats.name: Hazel
stats.vibe: Organised, proud of every streak and a little obsessive about records.
stats.story: Hazel is a squirrel who keeps track of everything, because squirrels bury thousands of nuts and have to remember where. She keeps your streaks, scores and records safe, and celebrates every one. She gets very excited about a personal best and a bit anxious when a streak is about to break, so please play today.

patients.name: Pippa
patients.vibe: Warm, organised and never forgets a thing. Purple cardigan, pink bow, notebook always in her trunk.
patients.story: Pippa is an elephant who spent years as a practice nurse, the one who remembered every patient's name, their dog's name and the question they forgot to ask. Elephants really do have long memories, and she uses hers for good: she keeps the patients' hub tidy so the answer you need is never more than two taps away. Her notebook is full of other people's questions. She thinks there is no such thing as a silly one.
